subject: Vendr inventory normalization & S3 evidence linking
messages:
From: Lisa Morton <lisa.morton@vendr.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: audits@vendr.com
Date: 2025-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Vendr portal - attribute mapping & evidence links needed

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for being responsive. Our onboarding scans against the Vendr inventory found a few mismatches between the attributes in your submitted profile and the canonical fields we use for the SOC2/SIG export. In particular we need:

- canonical keys for: data_retention_policy, kms_integration, network_segmentation, subdomain_list
- a CSV manifest that maps your current Vendr field names to our canonical keys
- links to the S3 buckets or presigned URLs for evidence artifacts (SOC2 report, encryption key policy, network diagram) — we can accept S3 paths and we will request presigned URLs if needed

Would you be able to send a mapping CSV and an evidence manifest by EOD next Wednesday? If not, we can schedule a 30-min call to walk the mapping.

We also attached our field spec for reference (I can push the portal record after we confirm mapping).

Appreciate it —
Lisa
Vendr Security Intake

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Morton <lisa.morton@vendr.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-21T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal - attribute mapping & evidence links needed

Hi Lisa —

Thanks — I pulled together an initial mapping and a manifest to start: vendr_attribute_map_v1.csv and s3_evidence_manifest.csv (attached). Quick summary of next steps from our side:

1) I will own the mapping spreadsheet and iterate with you on the keys you expect.
2) Markus (cc'd) will provide S3 paths and flag any restricted artifacts that need presigned URLs.
3) Evelyn (cc'd) will confirm whether redaction is required on any documents before sharing.
4) If you still need a sync, I'm available Thu 11/27 9:00-11:00 PT or Fri 11/28 13:00-15:00 PT — let me know what works.

A couple of notes:
- We maintain separate artifacts for our Hosted API vs Dedicated deployment. The manifest points to the canonical bucket for compliance artifacts (column: evidence_bucket_path).
- For SIG/CAIQ alignment, we included a column suggesting the closest SIG section (e.g., ENV-CTRL -> network_segmentation).

Markus, can you confirm which buckets will be used and whether we should generate presigned URLs or grant vendr read access?

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

From: Lisa Morton <lisa.morton@vendr.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: audits@vendr.com
Date: 2025-11-24T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal - attribute mapping & evidence links needed

Sofia —

Received, thanks. I reviewed the CSV and it looks like the mapping covers most fields. A couple of asks before we mark your record as complete in Vendr:

- Can you confirm the exact key you use for KMS/HSM integration (we need the field used in the API payload)
- Please provide one example presigned URL (short-lived) for an artifact so our ingestion can validate access controls

I attached our latest field spec (vendr_field_spec_2025-11.pdf) — it lists the exact keys we ingest. Tentatively schedule: Thu 11/27 at 9:30 PT to validate the sample.

Also, our buyers require evidence availability within 30 days of request — flagging for awareness.

Best,
Lisa

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Morton <lisa.morton@vendr.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-27T11:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal - attribute mapping & evidence links needed

Lisa —

Sharing the S3 locations below. These are the canonical evidence paths we will use for Vendr/Vendr-like integrations:

- s3://redwood-evidence/compliance/soc2/2025/vendor_vendr/redacted_soc2_report.pdf
- s3://redwood-evidence/compliance/soc2/2025/vendor_vendr/encryption_key_policy.docx
- s3://redwood-evidence/compliance/network/2025/vendor_vendr/network_diagram_redacted.pdf

Note: network_diagram and HSM/KMS SOPs contain PII/system identifiers and will require presigned URLs or temporary read grants. Please confirm which approach Vendr prefers; attached is a presigned URL request template (s3_presigned_request_template.txt) that your team can use to specify expiry and scope.

On the KMS field: we currently use "kms_provider.integrations.hsm_enabled" in our internal JSON schema — in the CSV I mapped that to your canonical key suggested in the field spec. If you need a different key, tell us and we'll align.

Evelyn — can you confirm whether the SOC2 report needs additional redaction before issuing presigned URLs?

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Security Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Lisa Morton <lisa.morton@vendr.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-30T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal - attribute mapping & evidence links needed

Markus / Sofia —

Thanks for the links and the template. We validated the presigned URL flow in our staging ingestion and it worked as expected. We'll proceed with the short-lived presigned URLs for the few restricted artifacts.

I'll mark the Vendr record as "pending final evidence" and will close it once we receive the sample presigned URLs (network diagram + HSM SOP). If anything else pops up, I'll open JIRA-SEC-1142 and loop you in.

Appreciate the quick turnaround —
Lisa
Vendr Security Intake
